'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is produced at the [[Church workbench]] by combining the basic fertilizer [[peat]] with an [[energy elixir]], the latter requiring an introduction to [[alchemy]]. Like all fertilizers, a single unit may be applied to a single farming plot - either an [[empty garden bed]], [[garden bed with sticks]], or [[vine trellis]] - in order to provide a benefit to the subsequently planted crop.

The benefit of a "Boost" fertilizer - note the hourglass icon - is an overall improvement to a crop's growth-rate. In regards to {{PAGENAME}} specifically, the given crop will grow 40% faster, reducing the 24 minute maturation of most crops down to ~15 minutes, or 2 in-game days. For additional information regarding the effects and use of fertilizer, see [[farming]].
